rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when something is readily apparent or easy to notice.

example.english: The recent rise in temperature is noticeable.
example.jyutping: ni1 paai4 hei3 wan1 ming4 hin2 gou1 zo2

rows.note: Choose this when something is especially conspicuous or stands out visually.

example.english: Your orange jacket is really noticeable.
example.traditional: 你件橙色外套真係好顯眼。
example.jyutping: nei5 gin6 caang2 sik1 ngoi6 tou3 zan1 hai6 hou2 hin2 ngaan5

rows.note: Use this when something is worthy of attention or note rather than merely easy to see.

example.english: This figure is noticeable enough to deserve attention.
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 sou3 geoi3 zik6 dak1 zyu3 ji3

rows.note: Choose this when “significant” means important or consequential.

example.english: This decision is important, and its impact is noticeable.
example.traditional: 呢個決定好重要，影響好明顯。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 kyut3 ding6 hou2 zung6 jiu3 jing2 hoeng2 hou2 ming4 hin2
